gates: Exact archived nearP/C SHA and decodedRGBA parity
Per-endpoint T/W/C and fertile/moist/dry reconstructed intervals consistent with measured code intervals (difference interval contains zero within2e-7 float allowance)
analysisUnits: Signed linearRGB differences per individual pixel pair, then average across fixed nine-pixel strips
groups: Twelve full-strip summaries (3xcenters*2poses*2lags) and three preselected near witness summaries
factorPathAccounting: sourcePathways preserves palette/brightness/weight routes; sourceRootTerms groups shared fertile direct palette, moisture, dry and weight contributions exactly once. Captured fertile/mineral are source-model roots; raw noise→fertile checked but no unsupported raw slope/mineral root decomposition.
intervals: Conservative +/-1 output code, exact bounded raw endpoints; no false independence or stochastic confidence interpretation. Monotone/clamp interval evaluation and all signed product corners, no early grayscale conversion.
censoring: Exclude any pair with color0or255 in P/C/T and exclude any endpoint without exact executed-mask255. Bounded raw0or255 remain one-sided intervals. Footprint upper saturation is reported unbounded.
limits: Root and pathway interval widths may be conservative because shared dependencies are not cancelled.
Unique signed-mean term is reported only if one interval magnitude exceeds every competitor in every RGB channel with no opposite-sign cancellation. Otherwise MIXED_OR_INCONCLUSIVE.
Descriptive mean contributions do not establish visual success, repair sufficiency, owner acceptance, or map-wide causality.
No aliasing claim from footprint alone.
No capture or renderer execution by this analyzer.
